purpose: Track Heineken price-source research without inflating country counts or losing reject/hold reasons.

counting.note: The exact pre-existing 16-country Heineken AUTO list was not preserved in repository history available during this research phase. Only countries proven new relative to that baseline may increase safe_minimum_auto_countries. Canada is proven new because its earlier GroceryPulse route had been rejected as paid before the BC government route was found.

status_definitions.baseline_known: Known member of the earlier AUTO baseline.
status_definitions.pass: Free/adequate free quota, automatable, regular Heineken evidenced, and public-app reuse/display basis is acceptable.
status_definitions.hold: Promising but at least one gate remains unresolved.
status_definitions.reject: Fails a required gate for this project.

sources.reject_reason: API-data third-party sharing/use restrictions conflict with public price-map redistribution requirements.
Primary retailer price data is not available for open API/redistribution according to the current operator.
Official API is technically accessible, but site-use terms are too restrictive for copying/storing/redistributing prices in this public project.
Website material distribution is prohibited without ATVR consent.
Acceptable-use restrictions conflict with competitive price comparison and accumulating response data into a public price-history database.
Storage/public-sharing restrictions conflict with daily persistence and public historical-price display.
Beer coverage is a fixed generic 2L light-beer basket item and does not reliably cover regular Heineken.
Selected product universe is too narrow; regular Heineken was not verified.
Selected monitored goods do not contain verified Heineken/beer coverage.
Dataset scope is agricultural/major foods and does not provide regular Heineken store prices.
